name: Colorado River — Ruby-Horsethief Canyons
gaugeName: Colorado River near Colorado-Utah State Line (USGS 09163500)
blurb: 25 miles of mostly flatwater through McInnis Canyons NCA from Loma, CO to Westwater, UT. Overnight camping permits required year-round.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Day use needs no permit; overnight camping permits required year-round (Recreation.gov 74466). No take-outs until Westwater. Take-out is in Utah. Mileage: BLM Ruby-Horsethief Canyon permits page.

notices.title: Permit
notices.text: BLM: overnight camping permits required year-round (Recreation.gov 74466); day use without permit.
